idea-plugin.name: LingxiCode AI
idea-plugin.description:
LingxiCode AI - An AI-powered toolkit for JetBrains IDEs that brings large language models directly into your daily coding workflow.

AI Commit Message Generation

  • One click in the Git commit dialog to generate a Conventional Commits message from the currently selected changes
  • Automatic diff collection with a configurable size limit, so large changesets are truncated gracefully
  • The generated message is filled into the commit message box and remains fully editable

AI Code Explanation

  • Select a code block, or simply place the caret inside a class, method, or function
  • Invoke from the editor context menu (shortcut: Alt+L) or the gutter icon on the left
  • Structured explanation displayed in a dedicated dialog with one-click copy of the full text

AI Code Review

  • Review the selected code, or the class/method/function at caret, from the context menu or the gutter icon
  • Multi-dimensional quality report (correctness, security, concurrency, robustness, performance, resource management, design, maintainability, readability, code style) ordered by importance, each dimension with its own suggestions
  • Report displayed in a dedicated dialog with one-click copy of the full text

AI Line-by-Line Comments

  • Generate a concise comment above each meaningful line of the selected code or the class/method/function at caret, preserving the code verbatim
  • Blank lines and closing-brace-only lines are skipped intelligently; comments follow the configured output language
  • Invoke from the editor context menu (shortcut: Alt+Shift+L) or the gutter icon, with one-click copy of the full text

Flexible Model Configuration

  • Built-in presets for OpenAI, DeepSeek, GLM (Zhipu), Kimi (Moonshot), MiniMax, Qwen (Alibaba) and Xiaomi MIMO, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint
  • Supports pay-as-you-go, Coding Plan and Token Plan endpoint types for the same provider
  • Fetch the available model list from the endpoint with one click, or type a custom model name
  • Switch the active model anytime via the status bar widget, without opening Settings

Privacy and Security

  • API keys are stored in the IntelliJ PasswordSafe and never written to disk
  • Requests are sent directly from your IDE to your own provider endpoint

More

  • UI language (Chinese / English) configurable in Settings, no IDE restart needed
  • Configurable AI output language (Chinese / English) and maximum diff size
  • Works with all JetBrains IDEs (IDEA, PyCharm, GoLand, WebStorm, and more) since 2024.2

中文简介

灵犀码（LingxiCode AI）— 面向 JetBrains IDE 的 AI 能力集插件，将大模型直接融入你的日常编码工作流。

  • AI 提交信息生成：在 Git 提交对话框一键根据勾选的代码变更生成 Conventional Commits 格式提交信息，自动回填且可继续编辑
  • AI 代码解释：选中代码或将光标置于类/方法/函数内，经右键菜单（快捷键 Alt+L）或行号旁图标一键生成结构化解释，支持复制全文
  • AI 代码评审：选中代码或将光标置于类/方法/函数内，经右键菜单或行号旁图标一键生成多维度质量评审报告（正确性、安全性、并发、健壮性、性能、资源管理、设计、可维护性、可读性、代码规范，按重要性排序，各维度附改进建议），支持复制全文
  • AI 逐行注释：为选中的代码或光标所在的类/方法/函数逐行生成简洁注释（空行、纯闭括号等无实义行智能跳过，代码原样保留），经右键菜单（快捷键 Alt+Shift+L）或行号旁图标触发，支持复制全文
  • 灵活的模型配置：内置 OpenAI / DeepSeek / GLM / Kimi / MiniMax / Qwen / Xiaomi MIMO 预设及任意自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点，支持按量付费 / Coding Plan / Token Plan 类型，一键获取模型列表，状态栏即可快速切换模型
  • 隐私与安全：API Key 经 IntelliJ PasswordSafe 安全存储，不落盘；请求由 IDE 直连你配置的服务商端点
  • 界面语言可在设置中切换（中文/English），即时生效，无需重启 IDE
  • AI 输出语言、Diff 最大字符数均可配置
